editorial:
Imagine a world of steam-powered gadgets and royal secrets where you have to play a dangerous game of hide-and-seek. You get to follow Team White Pigeon, a group of spies who are trying to save Princess Mary from some scary assassins. The cool part is that Ange, one of the lead spies, is actually the princess's own sister pretending to be a commoner. This creates a fun dynamic because you get to see the tension between the royal sisters while they dodge bombs and fight off bad guys in a city that looks like a steampunk dream.

You will love how the action scenes move quickly and keep you on your toes. The twists are surprising and the bond between the characters feels real and sweet. While the plot gets a bit complicated with all the political spying, it stays exciting enough to keep you hooked.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a huge showdown to stop the Cavorite bombs from blowing up. You see the characters team up to outsmart the villains and secure the safety of the throne. The biggest twist is how the sisters finally face their family issues while fighting for their lives. In the end, they stop the attack, save the princess, and the spies return to their secret work, knowing they saved the kingdom from total chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy stories and cool alternate worlds.
